Looking for a job where you can grow, work with modern technology, and make a real difference every day? You don’t need years of experience, we’re looking for the right attitude. Monthly salary of €2630,88 Full-time or part-time working options Extra bonuses for overtime and evening shifts from 18:00 onwards 8.33% holiday allowance Travel allowance of up to €9.30 per day Opportunities to obtain valuable logistics certifications Pension accrual after 8 working weeks Opportunities for career development and internal growth Possibility of a permanent contract Functieomschrijving At DHL, you’re not just another employee.
